description: This file defines the public API for the Open Supervised Device Protocol (OSDP), including command structures, enums, callback types, and API functions related to OSDP control, LED, buzzer, text display, keyset, and secure channel features.

methods.name: osdp_pd_set_command_callback
methods.description: Sets callback for PD command notifications when operating in PD mode.

methods.name: osdp_pd_notify_event
methods.description: Notifies CP of PD events, used as an alternate response to POLL.

methods.name: osdp_cp_send_command
methods.description: Enqueues a command to a specific PD.

methods.name: osdp_cp_set_event_callback
methods.description: Sets callback for CP event notifications when operating in CP mode.

methods.name: osdp_get_sc_status_mask
methods.description: Retrieves the current Secure Channel status mask.
